title: Hunter Radar
description:
Flagship product of TriPoint Innovations, LLC, backed by a $75,000 USDA grant
Integrates ESP32, Python, LoRa, GPS, BLE, and microcontroller hardware
Group tracking, boundary alerts, SOS signaling, and waypoint navigation without cell service
3.5-mile LoRa range and 12+ hour battery life across 2 field trials
3 prototype versions, 4 tracking nodes, and 3 enclosure iterations

images.description: AI-integrated tracking interface displaying real-time geolocation data in areas without cellular coverage.

title: 6.7L Cummins Cost Reduction Engineering
description:
Led teardown and inspection of one 6.7L Cummins engine and four additional engines
Conducted 40 hours of engine testing comparing aftermarket components against OEM standards
Documented test results, failure modes, and recommendations
Identified potential to reduce per-unit costs by approximately 30%

images.title: 6.7L Cummins - Aftermarket Assembly
images.description: 6.7L Cummins assembly with aftermarket components validated through 40 hour dynamometer testing to verify durability, performance, and system integrity

images.title: 6.7L Cummins - Aftermarket Part Validation
images.description: Disassembled the engine and performed detailed measurements on each component to evaluate multiple aftermarket part combinations per cylinder following the dynamometer test

title: NPDL Product Development Work
description:
CAD, prototypes, and test fixtures across 12 client hardware projects
Lateral lift oil recovery using bladder-driven pumping and proprietary valve architecture
Oil States automation with actuator-driven cap installation and production tooling
Other clients include a new shoelace holder development and Hopkins Manufacturing Corporation
3 CFD studies, 7 test fixtures, and patent drawings for IP filing

title: OSU Homecoming Engineering Build
description:
Led an 8-person engineering team and 30+ laborers building a 60 ft x 18 ft x 12 ft display
Integrated 8+ motors and actuators across 6 moving linkages with relay logic and timing controls
Used CAD, motion studies, and FEA to find failure causes in 3 metal components, preventing $4,500 in rework
Placed 1st of 12 in front of 200,000+ people at OSU Homecoming
